items.q: See, he's a -- got -- hired Greggman to come in to help him with the big three companies.

ctx.x: And I had made a trip down to visit my friend, Jack Robbins. And he had talked to me about a deal where he would support us in the arrangement.
See, he's a -- got -- hired Greggman to come in to help him with the big three companies. A lot of pictures were coming out of Hollywood and had all these hit songs.
He asked me if I would -- if we would broadcast from the Savoy once a week, coast to coast. And that was a very important broadcast.
